value.answer: Wet one tomorrow in Toronto. Showers early, then a 60% chance of showers the rest of the day, with a risk of thunderstorms morning and afternoon. Could get 10 to 20 mm of rain. High of 24, humidex 28, and windy from the southwest, gusting to 40 km/h around noon. Take an umbrella.
